about: Exchange sessions whose published price file is unusable. Each gap is unresolved: no price exists for it in this study, none is interpolated or invented, and the corrupt file is kept in the local cache under the checksum below for forensic review, never read as market data. Handling 'excluded' means no signal is generated and no trade is made on that session, and any valuation or return that spans it is flagged (see india/marks.py).
